summary: Package Center khong con mat muc Community khi dang co ban moi; NAS tai goi cap nhat tu GitHub nhanh va on dinh hon.
changes: Nguon /spkserver luon liet ke Coopeditor: trong luc NAS dang tai ban moi hoac khong goi duoc GitHub, Package Center van thay ban dang cai (truoc day danh sach rong lam DSM an ca muc Community). Nut Update hien khi goi moi da tai xong ve NAS.
Tai goi .spk tu GitHub bang 4 ket noi song song, moi doan 8 MB; doan nao dut thi tai lai rieng doan do thay vi tai lai tu dau; kiem tra md5 khi xong.
Kem cac thay doi cua rc64: che do Nhac chu cho kich ban, kiem tra ban moi moi 5 phut, thong bao cho chu workspace khi goi moi san sang.
